title: UI & Visual Designer senior path
summary: A step-by-step roadmap to deepen design expertise, build a standout portfolio, and prepare for senior-level roles. Focuses on advanced techniques, leadership, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations refresh
phases.summary: Strengthen core Visual principles and tool skills.

milestones.title: Typography fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Select and apply type systems confidently across interfaces.

tasks.title: Read typography basics on MDN
tasks.description: Study MDN’s typography guide to understand font families, weights, and line-height.

tasks.title: Create a type scale in Figma
tasks.description: Build a reusable type scale using modular ratios and apply it to a sample page.

tasks.title: Compare three brand type systems
tasks.description: Analyze typography choices in three well-known brands and note hierarchy patterns.

tasks.title: Reflect on readability improvements
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how the new type scale affects readability and visual balance.

milestones.title: Colour & layout fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Design balanced layouts with effective colour palettes.

tasks.title: Study colour theory on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Complete the colour theory module to learn contrast, harmony, and accessibility.

tasks.title: Build a 8-point grid system in Figma
tasks.description: Set up an 8-pixel grid and apply it to a simple dashboard mockup.

tasks.title: Apply an accessible palette to the mockup
tasks.description: Choose colours meeting WCAG AA contrast and update the dashboard design.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior designer on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Ask for feedback on your grid and palette choices and note suggestions.

phases.title: Core skills expansion
phases.summary: Deepen system thinking, prototyping, and handoff expertise.

milestones.title: Design systems architecture
milestones.outcome: Create reusable components and documentation for a cohesive UI library.

tasks.title: Read design systems handbook (Google)
tasks.description: Skim the open-source handbook to grasp token, component, and documentation strategy.

tasks.title: Build a component library in Figma
tasks.description: Design 5 core components (button, input, card, nav, toast) with variants and auto-layout.

tasks.title: Document usage guidelines
tasks.description: Write concise usage notes and accessibility tips for each component.

tasks.title: Reflect on scalability challenges
tasks.description: Note any difficulties keeping the system consistent and propose solutions.

milestones.title: Advanced prototyping & motion
milestones.outcome: Produce interactive, animated prototypes that communicate intent.

tasks.title: Watch Figma prototyping tutorials on YouTube
tasks.description: Watch two tutorials covering micro-interactions and overlay flows.

tasks.title: Create a multi-screen prototype
tasks.description: Link three app screens with transitions, overlays, and scrollable areas.

tasks.title: Add motion using Figmotion plugin
tasks.description: Animate a button press and a card reveal, keeping motion under 300 ms.

tasks.title: Gather peer feedback via a design community
tasks.description: Post the prototype in a forum and collect at least three constructive comments.

milestones.title: Efficient handoff practices
milestones.outcome: Deliver developer-ready specs and assets with minimal friction.

tasks.title: Read Figma handoff guide on Figma help Center
tasks.description: Understand how to use inspect mode, export settings, and design tokens.

tasks.title: Prepare a handoff file for a screen
tasks.description: Organize layers, name components, and generate CSS snippets for one screen.

tasks.title: Run a mock handoff meeting
tasks.description: Present the file to a peer acting as engineer and answer their questions.

tasks.title: Reflect on communication gaps
tasks.description: Write down any misunderstandings and how to clarify them in future handoffs.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that showcase senior-level design thinking.

milestones.title: Small design system project
milestones.outcome: A polished, documented design system ready for portfolio display.

tasks.title: Define scope and user needs
tasks.description: Write a brief brief outlining the system’s purpose and target audience.

tasks.title: Design core components
tasks.description: Create at least 8 components with variants and responsive layouts.

tasks.title: Write component documentation
tasks.description: Add usage guidelines, accessibility notes, and code snippets for each component.

tasks.title: Record a walkthrough video
tasks.description: Film a 2-minute walkthrough explaining the system’s structure and decisions.

tasks.title: Publish on Behance with case study
tasks.description: Upload the system, include problem statement, process, and outcomes.

milestones.title: Three polished app screens
milestones.outcome: High-fidelity screens that demonstrate visual hierarchy and interaction flow.

tasks.title: Select a real-world app problem
tasks.description: Identify a pain point in an existing app and define the redesign goal.

tasks.title: Sketch wireframes on paper
tasks.description: Create low-fidelity sketches for three screens covering onboarding, main view, and settings.

tasks.title: Design high-fidelity screens in Figma
tasks.description: Apply the design system, typography, and colour palette to produce polished screens.

tasks.title: Add micro-interactions prototype
tasks.description: Link screens and add subtle motion to buttons and transitions.

tasks.title: Write a case study narrative
tasks.description: Explain the problem, research, design decisions, and impact in 500 words.

milestones.title: Motion prototype of interaction
milestones.outcome: A dynamic prototype that illustrates complex motion and user feedback.

tasks.title: Choose an interaction to animate
tasks.description: Select a complex UI pattern such as drag-to-reorder or loading skeleton.

tasks.title: Storyboard the animation steps
tasks.description: Sketch each keyframe and note timing and easing curves.

tasks.title: Create the motion prototype in Figma
tasks.description: Use Figmotion or Smart Animate to build the full interaction with realistic timing.

tasks.title: Test with two peers and record feedback
tasks.description: Observe how users perceive the motion and note improvement ideas.

tasks.title: Update prototype based on feedback
tasks.description: Refine easing, duration, and visual cues to enhance clarity.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance leadership, interview prep, and senior-level positioning.

milestones.title: Design leadership & mentoring
milestones.outcome: Lead design reviews and mentor junior designers effectively.

tasks.title: Read “design leadership handbook” summary on Medium
tasks.description: Learn key practices for critique, vision setting, and team collaboration.

tasks.title: Facilitate a mock design critique
tasks.description: Run a 30-minute critique session with peers on one of your portfolio pieces.

tasks.title: Create a mentorship plan
tasks.description: Outline goals, meeting cadence, and feedback methods for a junior designer.

tasks.title: Reflect on leadership style strengths
tasks.description: Write a short self-assessment highlighting communication and decision-making strengths.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior design manager on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Ask for advice on scaling design systems in large organizations.

milestones.title: Senior interview preparation
milestones.outcome: Confidently articulate design process, impact, and system thinking in interviews.

tasks.title: Study common senior design interview questions on Glassdoor
tasks.description: Read at least five typical questions and note key themes.

tasks.title: Craft STAR stories for each portfolio project
tasks.description: Write concise Situation-Task-Action-Result narratives for your three projects.

tasks.title: Record a mock interview answer
tasks.description: Video yourself answering a design challenge and review body language.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a peer designer
tasks.description: Share the video and incorporate constructive criticism.

tasks.title: Update portfolio with interview-ready case studies
tasks.description: Polish each case study to highlight problem, process, and measurable outcomes.

milestones.title: Advanced motion & interaction trends
milestones.outcome: Apply motion principles to senior projects.

tasks.title: Explore motion design resources on motion design School
tasks.description: Watch two free lessons on fluid dynamics and UI micro-interactions.

tasks.title: Experiment with fluid animation in Figma
tasks.description: Create a prototype using spring easing and physics-based motion for a card stack.

tasks.title: Integrate motion with colour transitions
tasks.description: Design a theme switcher that animates colour changes smoothly.

tasks.title: Reflect on user perception of motion
tasks.description: Write notes on how the animations affect usability and delight.

tasks.title: Share findings in a design community post
tasks.description: Publish a short article summarizing experiments and lessons learned.
